name: Alvarezsaurus
sum: Small alvarezsaurid from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Argentina that gave its name to the group.
holotype: Partial postcranial skeleton from the Bajo de la Carpa Formation, Neuquén, Argentina (Bonaparte 1991).
biology: A lightweight biped with a long tail; its legs suggest a fast runner. The third metatarsal was the longest.
author: Bonaparte 1991
